    - win11cis_rule_18_9_7_1_5

    - level2-bitlocker
    - bitlocker

      ansible.windows.win_regedit:
        path: HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DeviceInstall\Restrictions\DenyDeviceClasses

        data: '{d48179be-ec20-11d1-b6b8-00c04fa372a7}'

    - name: "18.9.7.1.5 | PATCH | Ensure 'Prevent installation of devices using drivers that match these device setup classes: Prevent installation of devices using drivers for these device setup' is set to 'IEEE 1394 device setup classes' | IEEE 1394 devices that support the IEC-61883 Protocol Class"
